NASA awarded VIZLESAN INC an indefinite delivery vehicle with a $20 billion ceiling for custom computer programming and application development support services. The award was signed on July 8, 2026, and released publicly on November 19, 2026. The contract is reserved for small businesses and was awarded following full and open competition.

The work falls under the SEWP VI multiple-award government-wide acquisition contract, which provides NASA and other federal agencies with information technology solutions for communications and audio-visual needs. The period of performance began November 1, 2026.

posts.summary:
The Department of Energy awarded Accenture Federal Services LLC a blanket purchase agreement call valued at $300,000, with a ceiling of approximately $105.3 million. The award covers computer systems design services, specifically information technology and telecommunications support for the National Nuclear Security Administration's Office of Secure Transportation. The agreement was signed on November 19, 2026, and runs through December 31, 2027.

The call was awarded through full and open competition and supports business application development and related labor services. Accenture Federal Services will provide IT, telecommunications, and cybersecurity support to help the agency maintain and enhance its secure transportation systems and related technology infrastructure.

posts.summary:
The National Institutes of Health awarded a task order to Dynanet Corporation under the GSA Multiple Award Schedule on November 19, 2026. The task order, valued at approximately $7.3 million with a ceiling of $48.8 million, supports custom computer programming and professional services. The work runs through May 19, 2027, and was set aside for small business concerns through full and open competition.

Dynanet Corporation will provide information technology support services to the NIH under this task order. The award was made through the existing GSA MAS vehicle, allowing the agency to leverage established pricing and terms for these specialized technical services.
